text:
matt_c: Hey @hema @jorge — quick ask: running the private cluster perf harness for the new batching patch and seeing ~15% higher p95 on node set A vs our cloud baseline. Can someone help sanity-check the run?

hema: can you paste the exact command + env? which image and model?

matt_c: using image redwood/inference:canary-2026-03, model=redwood/gpt-small-quant, batcher=continuous, seq_len=512. Command used:
```
./bench/run_private.sh --model gpt-small-quant --seq 512 --clients 16 --duration 300 
```
Also enabled kv-cache warmup and prefix caching TTL=60.

jorge: thanks. Two quick asks: (1) what's NIC MTU on node A vs baseline? (2) kernel network offloads? both have bitten us before.

matt_c: MTU 9000 on both, ethtool shows GRO enabled on node A, baseline had GRO off. I can toggle and rerun.

liz_m: pinging @sre_oncall for any known noisy neighbors on cluster A during that window.

sre_oncall: no alerts in that timeframe. I checked node host metrics — CPU-steal ~0.0 but interrupts/sec spike on one host around start time. Could be driver/IRQ affinity.

hema: ok can you attach a flamegraph or perf top sample? If IRQs are unhappy that could cause tail jitter. Also share the bench harness log (we look for repeated small tail latencies).

matt_c: attaching pastebin log snippet: 
```
[run] clients=16 duration=300
[p99] 210ms p95 120ms p50 18ms
[token-rate] 760 t/s
[worker-0] stall 1x 180ms
[worker-3] stall 3x 90-120ms
```

jorge: those stalls line up with the IRQ spike. Quick test: try isolcpus= on the host or move the NIC irq to a dedicated CPU, and re-run single short 60s job. Also check /proc/irq/*/smp_affinity.

matt_c: trying isolated cpus now. also noticed transparent hugepages were enabled on node A but disabled in baseline. Changing to madvise and re-running after reboot.

ci-bot: CI note: bench run triggered by matt_c on canary image. Results uploaded to https://ci.redwood.dev/bench/2046001120

liz_m: small request: if you get a clean re-run, can you also run the on-prem harness with the same flags but --clients 8 and share the raw latency histogram? product wants a conservative p95 number for SRE ticket.

matt_c: will do. one more: should I pin the kernel to 5.15 (baseline) or leave current 5.19? Baseline is 5.15.

hema: pin to 5.15 for the comparison run. Kernel changes have affected NAPI/irq behavior in past releases. Put both kernel + ethtool settings into the bench ticket so infra can repro.

matt_c: noted. I'll run two 60s runs: (A) 5.15 + hugepages=never + GRO=off + IRQ affinity tuned; (B) current host defaults. Uploading results to the CI link when done. Thanks y'all. :thumbsup:

jorge: thanks — if A fixes it, we should add a small env-check to the private deploy onboarding checklist (kernel version, transparent_hugepage, ethtool offloads) so this doesn't keep recurring.

matt_c: +1. filing a tiny PR for checklist after validation.

sre_oncall: if you want, I can schedule a short maintenance window to repro with host-level fiddling, better to avoid noisy neighbor interference.

matt_c: appreciate it, will coordinate.

ci-bot: Benchmark artifacts: https://ci.redwood.dev/bench/2046001120/raw-logs.zip

hema: great — feel free to @me with the CI link once the two runs complete and I can do a quick compare diff (latency hist + stall traces).
